summary: -i is parsed into the unsigned iteration counter and bounds a host loop that launches the selected SpMV kernel once per timed iteration (unless numRows is zero). Each launch covers all rows, and each active thread/warp traverses its assigned CSR entries; the compiled device loop has backward branches around global loads and multiply-accumulates. No omitted/hoisted timed iterations identified.

source_evidence.claim: -i is assigned to iterations; each timed loop pass calls launch(), which dispatches a kernel covering dim rows. Each GPU subgroup sums CSR values/columns across row delimiters and writes its row result. A separate first launch/synchronize occurs outside the timed loop when iterations and numRows are nonzero.

compiled_evidence.claim: Host control increments the iteration counter and compares it to the parsed count before continuing the launch path; each pass calls the selected __device_stub__ for spmvGpu.

compiled_evidence.claim: The emitted group-size-2 and group-size-32 kernel bodies contain row-bound checks, CSR loads, fma operations, and backward conditional branches on the CSR traversal loop. PTX includes emitted variants for group sizes 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32.

Bound sm_86 group-size-32 device code performs CSR global loads and floating-point work, with a backward conditional BRA from the traversal body (0x400 back to 0x2e0); this is compiled loop control, not merely a kernel symbol.
